newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SES eases foreign currency debt securities listing.
newsitem.headline: SES eases foreign currency debt securities listing.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Singapore Ltd (SES) said on Thursday it has revised fees and requirements for foreign currency debt securities listings.
It said in a statement the initial listing fee remains Singapore $30 per US$1 million of nominal value of debt securities, subject to a minimium of S$1,000 and a maximum of S$5,000.

But additional fees payable for listing of additional debt securities of a series already listed had been dropped, it said. Differing rates per issue per year had been consolidated into a S$500 annual fee, the same as for medium-term note programmes.
SES said listing applications had also been simplified, with the number of documents required reduced to essentially two copies each of the draft propectus or offering memorandum.
The changes take effect immediately, the statement said.
